proposals.rationale: Hypothesis: omitting the argon-environment step could expose the air-sensitive catalyst/base/boron reagent mixture to ambient moisture or oxygen; this is not an observed failure claim.
Hypothesis: deleting the reactor-to-heater connection represents loss of the stated heating arrangement and could prevent the reaction vessel from receiving the intended 80 °C heating context.
Hypothesis: using the existing 2-minute duration for the heated step instead of the stated 12-hour hold could create an incomplete-conversion risk.
Hypothesis: substituting the already used B2pin2 reagent for benzamide at the substrate-addition step removes the stated substrate addition and creates a reagent-identity mismatch risk.
